methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Top federal broadband official visits Bedford County, touts connectivity
signals.signal_reading: Federal broadband infrastructure investment in historically underserved Bedford County creates the precondition for distributed AI capability, though connectivity alone doesn't guarantee depth without accompanying skills development.

signals.title: Emerald AI reaches unicorn status with $1.05B valuation - Virginia Business
signals.signal_reading: A unicorn-level AI company valuation ($1.05B) concentrated in NoVA demonstrates deep technical capability clustering in the metro hub, reinforcing the capital-talent gravity well that makes knowledge distribution challenging.

signals.title: Roanoke College joins Google AI for Education Accelerator - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's participation in Google's AI Education Accelerator signals institutional capacity-building outside NoVA that could seed distributed peer learning networks if translated into regional workforce development.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - WWBT
signals.signal_reading: A $50M+ data center infrastructure investment in Henrico adds 200 jobs but signals shallow, operations-focused AI adoption in Richmond rather than deep technical capability that could challenge NoVA's dominance.

signals.title: Camp Welcomes Hampton Roads Youth to Learn About Cybersecurity and AI - Old Dominion University
signals.signal_reading: Youth-focused cybersecurity and AI education camps at Old Dominion University represent early-stage capability seeding in Hampton Roads, potentially building distributed technical fluency if sustained through workforce pipelines.
